_meta.gameVersion: Set roster through Version 3.0.7 (2026-10). Set-bonus text: in-game OCR 2026-03 (v2.3.x), meta-builds.net export tagged game v3.0.5 (fetched 2026-09-25), fandom set pages (2026), 3.0.6 Treacherous Tides rework (2026-09-16). Base-stat tables: legacy pre-2.3.1 OHDB/Korean mirror (lReDragol) + post-2.3.1 Tier V 6-star OCR (2026-03-01).
_meta.notes: Direct web access to fandom/oncehumandb/meta-builds/oncehuman.game was blocked by the network proxy and the WebSearch budget ran out mid-task, so set texts were cross-checked across GitHub-hosted mirrors/exports of those sites plus search-result summaries. Percentages are plain numbers (12 = +12%). Set bonus and key-armor effect values do NOT scale with star or tier in any source; only Max HP / Psi Intensity (and legacy Pollution Resist by tier) scale. Base stats are identical for every piece sharing slot+rarity regardless of set. Each armor piece has exactly one armor-mod slot. Only one Key Armor piece can be equipped per loadout (0x91 note). lReDragol "common" rarity = in-game Uncommon (green).

starScaling.summary: Blueprint stars (1-6) and crafting tier (I-V) both scale the piece BASE STATS only (Max HP and Psi Intensity). Set bonuses and Key Armor special effects are fixed text with no star-dependent numbers in any source. Pollution Resist scales with tier but not with stars in the legacy table.

maxStarsByRarity.note: lReDragol calculator caps; the Korean/OHDB-derived table only has epic to 5 stars, rare to 4, uncommon(common) to 3. OHDB pages show epic pieces at 6-star-equivalent values (e.g. Agent Mask 333 HP), so the epic cap may be 6 in-game - unverified.

tierMultipliersFromTier1.appliesTo: all rarities, all slots (legacy table, 1-star column)

psiIntensity.note: legendary; epic/rare/uncommon differ by rounding (epic V = 5.93, rare V = 5.69, uncommon V = 5.82)

pollutionResistPost231.note: post-2.3.1 (Jan 21 2026) values seen on OHDB and in Mar-2026 OCR; intermediate tiers not found

starMultiplier.confidence: high (legacy era); post-2.3.1 per-star steps assumed unchanged (not directly observed)

post231Rebase.patch: Version 2.3.1 (2026-01-21) per 0x91CEA55 datamine notes: "Calibration system removed. Stats determined by rarity and star level"
post231Rebase.observed: Tier V 6-star legendary HP after 2.3.1 = exactly 1.25x the pre-2.3.1 6-star values (925 vs 740, 462 vs 370, 2405 vs 1924, 2220 vs 1776, 1388 vs 1110, 1850 vs 1480). Psi Intensity unchanged (115/144/80/92/86/58). Pollution Resist re-based (helmet/pants/gloves/shoes 12, mask/top 16 at T5).
post231Rebase.recommendedModel: maxHp(T5, star) = baseT1 * 9.8333 * 1.25 * (1 + 0.05*(star-1)) for current game; psi(T5,star) = baseT1 * 5.75 * (1 + 0.05*(star-1)) (legendary).

fullLegendaryT5Star6Total.note: sum of six legendary pieces at Tier V 6-star

legacyCalibrationPre231.note: Armor calibration (removed in 2.3.1). Max calibration level by tier: T1-2 -> 2, T3-4 -> 4, T5 -> 6.
